components.name: Chart/Annotation
components.description: Explains a moment in the data. Marker = event on the X axis (dashed rule + tag), Point = callout on one value, Range = shaded period. Max 3 per chart, tag ≤ 24 characters, never cover the latest value. React: <ChartAnnotation variant="marker|point|range" label x x2? y? />

4.18 Chart · Parts
BEK
Design System
Chart/Annotation
Explains a moment in the data: Marker for an event on the X axis, Point for one value, Range for a period. 3 variants.
Overview
What it is and when to reach for it.
Annotation
When to use
Something outside the data explains a change (price change, campaign, outage).
A single value needs a callout (record, target hit).
A period needs shading (holiday season, test window).

Usage
Rules that keep the chart honest and readable.
Max 3 annotations per chart.
Tag text ≤ 24 characters; details go into the hover tooltip.
Never cover the latest value or the line being explained.
Label: Annotation (Label property) on every variant.
Spec
Library-neutral contract — maps to Recharts, ECharts, D3, Visx, SwiftUI Charts or Compose.
Field
Definition
Purpose
Explains a moment in the data: Marker for an event on the X axis, Point for one value, Range for a period.
Encoding
x (and x2 for Range) ← event date · y ← value (Point) · label ← note
Interaction
Hover / tap shows the full note; click can open the related record.
Accessibility
Announced in the chart summary: “Annotation: Price change on 1 May”.
